# Jelena Rajković — Career Mentoring

> Jelena Rajković is a career-change mentor supporting women in mid-career who want clarity and a realistic next step. Her website presents individual mentoring, career articles, free resources, and ways to get in touch.

The website is bilingual: Montenegrin is the default language at the root, and English pages use the `/en` prefix with the same path segments. Some articles are available only in Montenegrin.

Use the linked pages for current mentoring details, resource availability, and contact information. The sitemap lists published articles and their available language versions.

## Montenegrin pages

- [Početna](https://jelena.rajkovic.coach/): Introduction to Jelena and her career mentoring approach.
- [O meni](https://jelena.rajkovic.coach/o-meni): Jelena's background and experience of changing careers.
- [Rad sa mnom](https://jelena.rajkovic.coach/rad-sa-mnom): Individual career mentoring and how to work with Jelena.
- [Karijerne bjeleške](https://jelena.rajkovic.coach/karijerne-bjeleske): Articles and reflections on careers and career change.
- [Besplatni resursi](https://jelena.rajkovic.coach/besplatni-resursi): Available free career resources and downloads.
- [Kontakt](https://jelena.rajkovic.coach/kontakt): Contact information and enquiry form.

## English pages

- [Home](https://jelena.rajkovic.coach/en): Introduction to Jelena and her career mentoring approach.
- [About](https://jelena.rajkovic.coach/en/o-meni): Jelena's background and career-change story.
- [Work with me](https://jelena.rajkovic.coach/en/rad-sa-mnom): Individual career mentoring and ways to work together.
- [Career notes](https://jelena.rajkovic.coach/en/karijerne-bjeleske): Career articles; English translations are available for some posts.
- [Free resources](https://jelena.rajkovic.coach/en/besplatni-resursi): Available free career resources and downloads.
- [Contact](https://jelena.rajkovic.coach/en/kontakt): Contact information and enquiry form.

- [Sitemap](https://jelena.rajkovic.coach/sitemap.xml): Public pages, published articles, and language alternatives.
